headline: Last session: Sensex ends 126 points lower, Nifty at 22,600 as market snaps two-week winning streak

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Market is closed today due to the weekend
The market snapped a two-week winning streak in the last trading session
Selling pressure in heavyweights like Jio Financial and Tata Steel weighed on indices
Increased volatility saw the India VIX rise by 6% during the last session
whatHappening: IndiGo and Air India are shifting flight operations to Navi Mumbai airport due to redevelopment at Mumbai's Terminal 1
The Madhya Pradesh semiconductor summit has attracted investment proposals worth ₹15,425 crore
The government has extended deadlines for corporates to file annual financial statements for FY26
Yes Bank is yet to decide on its AT-1 bond coupon payment, stating it retains full discretion
summary: The Indian stock market is closed for the weekend after the Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday, snapping a two-week rally. Major laggards in the last session included Jio Financial, Tata Steel, and Swiggy, which saw a sharp 17% decline. Corporate developments remain focused on aviation infrastructure shifts and semiconductor investment proposals.
